independent_solution.main_law_or_principle: Wave equation (v = fλ) and the principle of frequency invariance when an electromagnetic wave crosses a boundary between media. Definition of refractive index (n = c/v).
independent_solution.calculation_or_logic:
1. In vacuum: $c = fλ$. So, $f = c/λ$.
2. In the medium: The frequency $f$ remains constant. The speed of light in the medium is $v = c/n$.
3. The new wavelength $λ'$ in the medium is given by $v = fλ'$.
4. Substitute $v$ and $f$: $λ' = v/f = (c/n) / (c/λ) = (c/n) \times (λ/c) = λ/n$.
5. The decrease in wavelength is the initial wavelength minus the new wavelength: $Δλ = λ - λ'$.
6. Substitute $λ'$: $Δλ = λ - λ/n = λ(1 - 1/n) = λ((n-1)/n)$.
